meta.name: edgeone-makers-middleware
meta.description: Edge middleware for EdgeOne Makers — request interception, redirects, rewrites, auth guards, A/B testing, and header injection at the edge (V8 runtime).

copy.tagline: 在边缘拦截请求、重定向、注入头部并做A/B测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在EdgeOne边缘运行时自定义请求行为
copy.tagline_en: Intercept requests, redirect, inject headers, and run A/B tests at the edge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to customize request behavior on EdgeOne edge runtime

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你编写在 EdgeOne 边缘节点运行的中间件代码，实现请求拦截、重定向、重写、身份验证、A/B 测试和添加请求头等功能。
howto.when: 当你需要为 EdgeOne Makers 项目添加边缘中间件逻辑，例如处理 URL 重定向、权限校验或地理路由时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个中间件，把 /old-page 重定向到 /new-page。
say.note: 生成 URL 重定向中间件代码。

say.text: 为 /api/* 路由添加 Bearer token 验证。
say.note: 生成身份验证中间件代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write middleware code that runs at the EdgeOne edge node, enabling request interception, redirects, rewrites, auth guards, A/B testing, and header injection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add edge middleware logic for an EdgeOne Makers project, such as URL redirects, permission checks, or geo-based routing.

say_en.text: Write a middleware that redirects /old-page to /new-page.
Add Bearer token validation for /api/* routes.
Write an A/B testing middleware that randomly rewrites /landing to /landing-a or /landing-b.
